import sys, json, os, math, random, time
import numpy as np

# ---------- read inputs ----------
json_path = sys.argv[1]
budget = float(sys.argv[2])  # wall‑clock budget in seconds
# (also available as env var QAP_TIME_LIMIT_S, but argv takes precedence)

with open(json_path, "r") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

n = data["n"]
A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=np.int64)
B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=np.int64)

# ---------- cost evaluation ----------
def cost(p):
    """Return sum_{i,j} A[i,j] * B[p[i], p[j]]"""
    # B indexed by the permutation: rows = p[i], cols = p[j]
    return np.sum(A * B[p][:, p])

# ---------- initial solution ----------
curr = np.arange(n)  # start from identity
curr_cost = cost(curr)
best = curr.copy()
best_cost = curr_cost

# ---------- simulated annealing ----------
start_time = time.time()
elapsed = 0.0
T = 1.0  # initial temperature
cooling = 0.9995
max_iter_no_improve = 10000  # safety guard

while elapsed < budget - 0.5:  # leave a small margin
    # stop if we are too close to the deadline
    if time.time() - start_time > budget - 0.5:
        break

    # propose a 2‑swap
    i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
    new_perm = curr.copy()
    new_perm[i], new_perm[j] = new_perm[j], new_perm[i]
    new_cost = cost(new_perm)

    delta = new_cost - curr_cost
    if delta < 0 or random.random() < math.exp(-delta / T):
        curr, curr_cost = new_perm, new_cost
        if curr_cost < best_cost:
            best, best_cost = curr, curr_cost

    # temperature update
    T *= cooling
    if T < 1e-5:
        T = 1e-5

# ---------- output ----------
perm_1based = best + 1  # convert to 1‑based indices
print("PERMUTATION:", " ".join(map(str, perm_1based)))

import sys, json, time, random, math
import numpy as np

# ---------- input ----------
json_path = sys.argv[1]
budget = float(sys.argv[2])          # wall‑clock budget in seconds
with open(json_path) as f:
    data = json.load(f)

n = data["n"]
A = np.asarray(data["A"], dtype=np.int64)
B = np.asarray(data["B"], dtype=np.int64)

# ---------- cost ----------
def cost(p):
    """Quadratic assignment cost for permutation p (0‑based)."""
    return np.sum(A * B[p][:, p])

# ---------- neighbourhood ----------
def neighbours(p):
    """Yield all 2‑swap neighbours of p."""
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            q = p.copy()
            q[i], q[j] = q[j], q[i]
            yield q

# ---------- greedy 2‑opt hill climbing ----------
def hill_climb(start):
    """Greedy improve using only improving 2‑opt moves."""
    p = start.copy()
    best = p
    best_cost = cost(p)
    while True:
        improved = False
        best_delta = 0
        best_neigh = p
        # evaluate all 2‑swaps (n is tiny, brute force is fine)
        for q in neighbours(p):
            c = cost(q)
            delta = c - best_cost
            if delta < best_delta:          # more negative = better improvement
                best_delta = delta
                best_neigh = q
        if best_delta < 0:                  # improvement found
            p = best_neigh
            best_cost = best_cost + best_delta
            improved = True
        if not improved:
            break
        if time.time() - start_time > budget - 0.5:
            break
    return p, best_cost

# ---------- main search ----------
start_time = time.time()
best_perm = None
best_cost = np.inf

# number of restarts adaptively limited by time
while True:
    # stop if we are too close to the deadline
    if time.time() - start_time > budget - 0.7:
        break

    # random start permutation
    cur = np.arange(n)
    random.shuffle(cur)

    # greedy improvement
    cur, cur_cost = hill_climb(cur)

    # keep global best
    if cur_cost < best_cost:
        best_perm, best_cost = cur, cur_cost

    # optional: short local search with random 2‑opt moves (simulated annealing)
    T = 1.0
    while time.time() - start_time < budget - 0.7:
        i, j = random.sample(range(n), 2)
        new_perm = cur.copy()
        new_perm[i], new_perm[j] = new_perm[j], new_perm[i]
        new_cost = cost(new_perm)
        delta = new_cost - cur_cost
        if delta < 0 or random.random() < math.exp(-delta / T):
            cur, cur_cost = new_perm, new_cost
            if cur_cost < best_cost:
                best_perm, best_cost = cur, cur_cost
        T *= 0.9999
        if T < 1e-5:
            T = 1e-5
        if time.time() - start_time > budget - 0.7:
            break

# ---------- output ----------
perm_1based = best_perm + 1
print("PERMUTATION:", " ".join(map(str, perm_1based)))
